annotations.title: TIA — delete HMI Unified tag table

description: Deletes a tag table of a WinCC Unified HMI. Refused, nothing changed: 404 not_found, 409 default_tag_table for the default table, 409 tag_table_not_empty (details.tags) while it holds tags unless recursive:true, which deletes its tags with it, and 409 tag_in_use (details.references) when an alarm references any of those tags. Screens, scripts and logging that use the tags are NOT scanned: run tia_hmi_validate afterwards. A recursive delete that stops part-way is 409 tag_table_delete_incomplete: the project IS partially changed (the tags already removed stay removed), so re-read with tia_hmi_tags before repeating it. A dryRun lists the tags and the group path; a real delete answers {hmi, tagTable, deleted:true, removedTags, postcheck:{exists:false, tagsRemaining:0}}. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs every guard the real write runs and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", hmi, ...} with no `postcheck`, changing nothing. A real write answers the re-read values and a `postcheck` {verified:true, requested, actual}; a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches, details.rollback: restored, not_restored or not_attempted): re-read before anything else. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to DELETE /hmi/{hmi}/tagtables/{table}?recursive=true. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

recursive.description: confirm deleting a table that still holds tags: every tag in it is deleted with the table

table.description: tag table name, as listed by tia_hmi_tag_tables
